title: 22.11. Kusalattika, Arūpāvacaraduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ naarūpāvacaraṁ dhammaṁ paccayā kusalo arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
Nakusalaṁ nanaarūpāvacaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato naarūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā pañca, adhipatiyā pañca …pe… avigate pañca.
